description: Two views of the same small chibi pixel art character, bald, with long pointed ears: on the left seen from the front, on the right seen from behind. Paint only inside the white of the mask: give the bald head a young man's thick curly hair: a full rounded crop of big springy curls all over the head, a few curls falling over the forehead as the bangs and curls around the ears. The bangs are natural everyday bangs, like ordinary hair: a few soft locks of different lengths with tapered pointed tips coming down to just above the eyes, a little forehead showing between them, never a straight horizontal edge and never a broad bare band of forehead. The hair covers the whole top of the head. It falls in clear thick locks with darker lines between them, and the outer silhouette stays rounded and scalloped with distinct curl clusters; only loose fringe tips taper into points. The same hairstyle in both views, in big bold locks. The hair is one bright grass green, shaded only with darker greens and outlined with the same thick dark outline, with no other colours inside the hair. The long pointed ears still poke out through the hair. Do not change the face, the eyes, the body or the clothes. Keep the same chunky pixel size and the same flat shading, nothing else added, transparent background.
